rasterAssets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production decorative cemetery PRINT asset for a functioning web login form. Input image is STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY: look exclusively at SECOND phone in top row, its upper cemetery illustration above SIGN IN. Do not edit or reproduce the whole phone/UI. Deliver one wide horizontal strip, approximately 3:1 aspect (1536 by512 ideal), transparent background. Match the reference's coarse distressed black/off-white two-ink photocopied gothic zine print: nearly black upper field, pale irregular graveyard skyline beneath it forming a low cream/transparency arch, large slim outlined cemetery cross near x30%, tiny floating plus cross near x12%, upright cream cross near x51%, scratchy five-point star near x86%, dense varied tiny gravestones and crosses rising on a rough curved skyline around lower half, spattered hand-inked right-side sloping cemetery fence. Black upper field reaches upper and side boundaries. The lower CENTER after 60% of strip height must become transparent for the real DOM heading below, with rough stippled edge and sparse black ink flecks. Natural uneven linework, rough ink erosion and paper holes; NO smooth clean vector linework, evenly repeated crosses, regular dot grid, or modern gradients. COLORS: black ink #191817 and warm off-white #eee5d6 only. TRANSPARENCY at the lower center opening and background holes. NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO frame/titlebar, NO input/button/checkbox, NO controls, NO characters or people, NO vertical accent rails/borders. This is artwork alone, not a screenshot or mockup.
